# The curated model

What a rule reads when it matches a model kind (`match: { kind: Class }`).
Every class, with its base, its subclasses and its fields; a field of a
base is readable on every subclass (`node.name` on a `Class` is `Decl`'s).
Each field gives the type the rule checker sees: a class name, `list(T)`,
`bool`, `string`, `int`, `double`. An enum is an `int`, compared with its
values by name (`node.kind == SubroutineKind.Task`). A field of class type
can be null: guard it (`node.base != null && ...`). `--check-rules` refuses a
field that does not exist, at its column.

Search this file for a class (`## Call`) or a field (`- \`subroutine\``).

## struct Location

Where a node is: the run's file id and the 1-based line and column of its first character, with macro expansions mapped to where the macro is used. `extent` is the length when it ends on the same line, else 0. All -1 when the node has no location.

- `fileid`: int
- `lineno`: int
- `linepos`: int
- `extent`: int

## SemNode

*subclasses: `Design`, `Unit`, `UnitDep`, `Decl`, `TypeRef`, `Stmt`, `CaseItem`, `Expr`.*

The root of every curated node.

- `location` `Location`: where the node is
- `macro` `string`: the macro whose expansion made the node, outermost first when expansions nest (`uvm_object_utils`); empty when the node is written out (what `macro_of` reads)

## Design

*extends `SemNode`.*

One compilation, lowered: the root the rules walk.

- `packages` `list(Package)`: every package, user and library, in compilation order
- `definitions` `list(Definition)`: the modules, interfaces and programs
- `items` `list(Decl)`: declarations outside any package or definition (`$unit`)
- `types` `list(TypeRef)`: every type a declaration or expression has, once each (TypeRef)
- `units` `list(Unit)`: the context units; empty until classify runs
- `deps` `list(UnitDep)`: the dependency edges between units; empty until classify runs

## enum UnitDepKind

What a UnitDep comes from.

- `UnitDepKind.Import`: a package import
- `UnitDepKind.TypeRef`: a reference to a type declared in the other unit
- `UnitDepKind.Include`: an `include` of the other unit's file
- `UnitDepKind.HierRef`: a hierarchical reference
- `UnitDepKind.VirtualInterface`: a virtual interface of the other unit's interface

## Unit

*extends `SemNode`; made by the classify stage (contexts).*

A context unit: one or more carriers (packages, definitions, classes) with their labels. Carriers with the same unit name are one unit: a classifier's `joins:` gives the carriers it joins its name.

- `name` `string`: the unit's name (`apb` in `agent(apb)`): a tag's, a classifier's `name:`, else the carrier's
- `labels` `list(string)`: its labels, on every axis, each once: those that select (`applies_to`, context overrides); a label only convention gives is not here
- `conventionLabels` `list(string)`: the labels only convention gives it (they never select; for `--contexts` and consistency rules)
- `carriers` `list(Decl)`: the carriers it is made of
- `evidence` `list(string)`: where each label came from, one line each: `unit agent: Content (r.yaml:12) on Package apb_pkg`
- `disagreements` `list(string)`: where a weaker source disagrees with the one used, one line each (`convention (r.yaml:3) says 'agent', but content says 'base-lib' on axis 'unit'`): what a consistency rule reports

## UnitDep

*extends `SemNode`; made by the classify stage (contexts).*

A dependency of one unit on another.

- `kind` `int` (enum `UnitDepKind`)
- `from` `Unit`
- `to` `Unit`

## enum DefinitionKind

What a Definition is.

- `DefinitionKind.Module`: `module`
- `DefinitionKind.Interface`: `interface`
- `DefinitionKind.Program`: `program`

## enum SubroutineKind

A function or a task.

- `SubroutineKind.Function`: `function`
- `SubroutineKind.Task`: `task`

## enum ProcessKind

What a Process is.

- `ProcessKind.Initial`: `initial`
- `ProcessKind.Final`: `final`
- `ProcessKind.Always`: `always`
- `ProcessKind.AlwaysComb`: `always_comb`
- `ProcessKind.AlwaysFF`: `always_ff`
- `ProcessKind.AlwaysLatch`: `always_latch`

## enum ArgDirection

A formal argument's direction.

- `ArgDirection.NotArg`: not a formal argument
- `ArgDirection.In`: `input`, or no direction
- `ArgDirection.Out`: `output`
- `ArgDirection.InOut`: `inout`
- `ArgDirection.Ref`: `ref`
- `ArgDirection.ConstRef`: `const ref`

## Decl

*extends `SemNode`; subclasses: `Package`, `Definition`, `Class`, `Typedef`, `Variable`, `Subroutine`, `Process`, `GenBlock`, `OpaqueDecl`.*

A named declaration.

- `name` `string`: the declared name
- `qname` `string`: the name qualified by its package or definition (`uvm_pkg::uvm_object`)
- `inLibrary` `bool`: declared in library code (uvm_pkg, or a configured VIP); its subroutines have no bodies
- `carrier` `Decl`: the package or definition the declaration is in, however deeply; null in `$unit`. A file included into a package (`` `include ``) is in that package
- `tags` `list(string)`: the context tags in the comments before a package, definition or class (`// svcheck context: agent(apb)` gives `agent(apb)`), each as written

## Package

*extends `Decl`.*

A package: a context carrier.

- `imports` `list(Package)`: the packages it imports (`import p::*;` or `import p::x;`), each once
- `files` `list(string)`: the files its text comes from: its own, then each file included into it
- `items` `list(Decl)`: its declarations

## Definition

*extends `Decl`.*

A module, interface or program definition (not an instance): a context carrier.

- `kind` `int` (enum `DefinitionKind`): module, interface or program
- `imports` `list(Package)`: the packages it imports
- `files` `list(string)`: the files its text comes from
- `items` `list(Decl)`: its declarations: variables, subroutines, classes, processes and generate blocks, from its first instance (generate blocks: GenBlock)

## Class

*extends `Decl`.*

A class declaration. A parameterised class is one Class, its generic body; each specialisation of it refers to this node.

- `base` `Class`: the class it extends, or null
- `supers` `list(Class)`: every class it derives from, nearest first
- `interfaces` `list(Class)`: the interface classes it implements, or an interface class extends, with those they extend, and those its bases implement
- `isAbstract` `bool`: declared `virtual class`
- `isInterface` `bool`: an `interface class`
- `params` `list(string)`: the names of its parameters, value and type; empty when it has none
- `members` `list(Decl)`: its own members, in declaration order

## Typedef

*extends `Decl`.*

A `typedef`; `type` is the aliased type.

- `type` `TypeRef`

## Variable

*extends `Decl`.*

A variable: a class property, a package or module variable, a local or a subroutine argument.

- `type` `TypeRef`: its type
- `isRand` `bool`: `rand` or `randc`
- `isStatic` `bool`: `static`
- `isConst` `bool`: `const`
- `direction` `int` (enum `ArgDirection`): a formal argument's direction; NotArg for any other variable
- `init` `Expr`: its initializer, or null; a formal argument's default value (user code only)

## Subroutine

*extends `Decl`.*

A function or task, with its body for user code.

- `kind` `int` (enum `SubroutineKind`): function or task
- `isVirtual` `bool`: virtual, declared so or inherited
- `isPure` `bool`: `pure virtual`
- `isStatic` `bool`: `static`
- `overrides` `Subroutine`: the base-class method it overrides, or null
- `returnType` `TypeRef`: the return type; `void` for a task
- `args` `list(Variable)`: its formal arguments
- `body` `Stmt`: its statements, as a Block (one with a single statement too), or null (library code, a prototype)

## Process

*extends `Decl`.*

A procedural block of a module, interface or program (`initial`, `always`, ...), with its body for user code. It has no name.

- `kind` `int` (enum `ProcessKind`): which block
- `body` `Stmt`: its statement, or null (library code)

## GenBlock

*extends `Decl`.*

A generate block of a module, interface or program: a branch of a generate `if` or `case`, or the body of a generate `for`. One node per block as written, as for definitions: its items come from the first instance that elaborates it, so a definition instantiated with several parameter sets gives each block once. A `for` body is lowered once, from its first iteration. A block that no instance elaborates (a branch every instance's parameters rule out) is here, with `isElaborated` false and no items.

- `isLoop` `bool`: the body of a generate `for`
- `isElaborated` `bool`: some instance elaborates it; else it has no items
- `items` `list(Decl)`: its declarations: variables, processes, nested blocks

## OpaqueDecl

*extends `Decl`.*

A declaration the model does not curate (a constraint, a covergroup, a parameter, ...): slang's symbol kind, and its name.

- `slangKind` `string`

## TypeRef

*extends `SemNode`.*

A type, as a declaration or expression has it: what `type_of` gives. Two uses of one type, as slang knows it, share a TypeRef. A typedef's name is kept: `item_t` is not `my_item`, though both are that class.

- `name` `string`: the type, as slang prints it (`int`, `uvm_pkg::uvm_config_db#(virtual bus_if)`)
- `isClass` `bool`: a class handle
- `classDecl` `Class`: the class, for a class handle: a specialisation's generic class
- `args` `list(TypeRef)`: a class specialisation's type arguments, in parameter order; value parameters are left out
- `isVirtualInterface` `bool`: a virtual interface
- `ifaceDecl` `Definition`: the interface, for a virtual interface
- `isIntegral` `bool`: an integral type (bits, logic, int, enum, packed struct)
- `isFourState` `bool`: an integral type whose bits can be X or Z (`logic`, `integer`)
- `isString` `bool`: `string`
- `bitWidth` `int`: the width in bits of an integral type; 0 for another type

## enum CaseCondition

How a case compares its items.

- `CaseCondition.Normal`: `case`
- `CaseCondition.WildcardXOrZ`: `casex`
- `CaseCondition.WildcardJustZ`: `casez`
- `CaseCondition.Inside`: `case ... inside`

## enum CaseCheck

A case's uniqueness qualifier.

- `CaseCheck.NoCheck`: none
- `CaseCheck.Unique`: `unique`
- `CaseCheck.Unique0`: `unique0`
- `CaseCheck.Priority`: `priority`

## enum BlockKind

How a block runs its statements.

- `BlockKind.Sequential`: `begin ... end`, or a subroutine's statement list
- `BlockKind.JoinAll`: `fork ... join`
- `BlockKind.JoinAny`: `fork ... join_any`
- `BlockKind.JoinNone`: `fork ... join_none`

## enum TimingKind

What a Timed statement waits for.

- `TimingKind.Delay`: a delay: `#5`, `#5ns`, `#(a, b, c)`, `#1step`
- `TimingKind.Event`: an event: `@(posedge clk)`, `@(e)`, `@*`, `repeat (n) @(e)`
- `TimingKind.Cycle`: a cycle delay: `##2`
- `TimingKind.Wait`: `wait (cond)`
- `TimingKind.WaitFork`: `wait fork`
- `TimingKind.WaitOrder`: `wait_order (a, b)`

## enum AssertKind

An immediate assertion's kind.

- `AssertKind.Assert`: `assert`
- `AssertKind.Assume`: `assume`
- `AssertKind.Cover`: `cover`

## Stmt

*extends `SemNode`; subclasses: `Block`, `ExprStmt`, `VarDecl`, `If`, `Case`, `Loop`, `Timed`, `Disable`, `Return`, `ImmediateAssert`, `OpaqueStmt`.*

A statement.


## Block

*extends `Stmt`.*

A `begin ... end` or `fork ... join` block, or a subroutine's statement list.

- `kind` `int` (enum `BlockKind`): sequential, or the fork's join
- `label` `string`: the block's name (`begin : drain`), or empty
- `stmts` `list(Stmt)`: its statements, in order

## ExprStmt

*extends `Stmt`.*

An expression evaluated for its effect (a call, an assignment).

- `expr` `Expr`: the expression
- `isVoidCast` `bool`: written `void'(f(...));`, a function call whose result is thrown away on purpose. slang keeps no cast for it, so `expr` is the call itself; a `void'` inside an expression is a Conversion

## VarDecl

*extends `Stmt`.*

A local variable declaration.

- `var` `Variable`

## If

*extends `Stmt`.*

An `if`.

- `cond` `Expr`: the condition
- `ifTrue` `Stmt`: the statement when it holds
- `ifFalse` `Stmt`: the `else` statement, or null

## Case

*extends `Stmt`.*

A `case`, `casex`, `casez` or `case ... inside`.

- `check` `int` (enum `CaseCheck`): unique, unique0, priority or none
- `condition` `int` (enum `CaseCondition`): how items compare
- `expr` `Expr`: the expression compared
- `items` `list(CaseItem)`: the items, in order
- `defaultCase` `Stmt`: the `default` statement, or null

## CaseItem

*extends `SemNode`.*

One item of a Case.

- `exprs` `list(Expr)`
- `body` `Stmt`

## Loop

*extends `Stmt`.*

A loop: `for`, `foreach`, `while`, `do ... while`, `repeat`, `forever`.

- `slangKind` `string`: slang's statement kind (`ForLoop`, `ForeachLoop`, ...)
- `vars` `list(Variable)`: the variables it declares: `i` in `for (int i = 0; ...)`, each loop variable of a `foreach`
- `exprs` `list(Expr)`: its control expressions (condition, steps, count; a `for` loop's initializers when it declares no variable)
- `body` `Stmt`: its body

## Timed

*extends `Stmt`.*

A statement that waits: a delay or event control before a statement (`#5 x = 1;`, `@(posedge clk);`), `wait`, `wait fork`, `wait_order`. Time passes here, so a rule asking whether code consumes time looks for these (and for calls of tasks).

- `kind` `int` (enum `TimingKind`): what it waits for
- `exprs` `list(Expr)`: what the wait reads: the delay (`exprs[0]` for a Delay or Cycle), the events' expressions and `iff` conditions, the `wait` condition, the `wait_order` events; empty for `@*` and `wait fork`
- `body` `Stmt`: the statement it controls, or null (`#5;`, `wait fork`); `wait_order`'s pass statement

## Disable

*extends `Stmt`.*

`disable name` or `disable fork`.

- `isFork` `bool`: `disable fork`
- `target` `string`: the name disabled (a block's label, or a task), as written; empty for `disable fork`

## Return

*extends `Stmt`.*

A `return`, with its value or null.

- `expr` `Expr`

## ImmediateAssert

*extends `Stmt`.*

An immediate `assert`, `assume` or `cover`.

- `kind` `int` (enum `AssertKind`)
- `cond` `Expr`
- `pass` `Stmt`
- `fail` `Stmt`

## OpaqueStmt

*extends `Stmt`.*

A statement the model does not curate: slang's statement kind, and its statements and expressions, so that what is inside it is still walked.

- `slangKind` `string`
- `stmts` `list(Stmt)`
- `exprs` `list(Expr)`

## enum ConstKind

Whether an expression has a constant value, and of what kind.

- `ConstKind.NotConst`: not a constant, or not one the model keeps
- `ConstKind.Int`: an integer with no X or Z bits, that fits 64 bits
- `ConstKind.String`: a string
- `ConstKind.Real`: a real or time value (`1.5`, `5ns`), in the time unit of its scope for a time literal

## Expr

*extends `SemNode`; subclasses: `Call`, `NewClass`, `Assign`, `NamedValue`, `MemberAccess`, `Literal`, `Conversion`, `OpaqueExpr`.*

An expression.

- `type` `TypeRef`: its type
- `constKind` `int` (enum `ConstKind`): whether it is a constant (a literal, a parameter, an enum value, or an operator over those), and of what kind: what `const_value` reads
- `constInt` `int`: its value, when constKind is Int
- `constString` `string`: its value, when constKind is String
- `constReal` `double`: its value, when constKind is Real
- `isDefault` `bool`: an argument the call leaves out, filled in from its formal's default; its location is the default's, in the subroutine's declaration

## Call

*extends `Expr`.*

A call of a subroutine, a built-in method (`randomize`) or a system task or function.

- `name` `string`: the subroutine's name
- `subroutine` `Subroutine`: the subroutine called, or null for a built-in or system one
- `isSystem` `bool`: a built-in method or system subroutine (`randomize`, `$display`)
- `isSuper` `bool`: called through `super.`
- `classType` `TypeRef`: the class the subroutine is a member of, as the call names it: `uvm_config_db#(virtual bus_if)` for `uvm_config_db#(virtual bus_if)::get(...)`; null for a subroutine outside a class
- `receiver` `Expr`: the object a method is called on (`obj` in `obj.m()`), or null
- `args` `list(Expr)`: the arguments, in the formals' order, each one the call leaves out filled in from its default (`isDefault`)

## NewClass

*extends `Expr`.*

`new(...)` of a class: `type.classDecl` is the class constructed. `super.new(...)` in a constructor is one too, with `isSuper`: it constructs nothing, and its type is `void`.

- `isSuper` `bool`: `super.new(...)`, the base class's constructor called from a constructor
- `args` `list(Expr)`: the constructor's arguments, in the formals' order, with defaults filled in (`isDefault`)

## Assign

*extends `Expr`.*

An assignment, blocking or not.

- `lhs` `Expr`
- `rhs` `Expr`
- `isNonBlocking` `bool`

## NamedValue

*extends `Expr`.*

A reference to a variable or other value by name; `decl` is it, when lowered.

- `name` `string`
- `decl` `Decl`

## MemberAccess

*extends `Expr`.*

`value.member`; `decl` is the member, when lowered.

- `value` `Expr`
- `member` `string`
- `decl` `Decl`

## Literal

*extends `Expr`.*

A literal, as written.

- `text` `string`

## Conversion

*extends `Expr`.*

A cast, written (`void'(x)`, `int'(x)`) or implicit; `type` is the target type.

- `operand` `Expr`
- `isImplicit` `bool`

## OpaqueExpr

*extends `Expr`.*

An expression the model does not curate: slang's expression kind, and its operands, so that what is inside it is still walked.

- `slangKind` `string`
- `operands` `list(Expr)`
